summary: Diff implements a frontend retired screen, route gating, and a neutral retired theme, plus introduces hooks for website status and admin actions. Backend introduces a WebsiteState type, migration, and guards via requireActiveForNonAdmin in some profile methods, but the diff is truncated so several backend/admin requirements cannot be fully verified from the provided evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a public query to read current site status (retired flag + optional public message) and an admin-only update method to set retired state/message; non-admin callers cannot change retired state.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.getWebsiteStatus() and actor.retireWebsite(message), but the backend diff snippet does not show the definitions/authorization checks for getWebsiteStatus/retireWebsite (or how admins are determined for that operation).

missing_requirements.requirement: When retired, block all non-admin, non-status backend operations (generation history get/add/update/delete; profile get/save) with a clear English 'site is retired' error; admin access should still work; homepage content query should still work or be replaced safely.
missing_requirements.reason: Some profile methods call requireActiveForNonAdmin(caller), but the diff does not show the implementation of requireActiveForNonAdmin nor the generation history APIs (get/add/update/delete) to confirm they all trap with the required English retired message for non-admins while allowing admins.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin-only purge operation that deletes all user profiles and generation history, only allowed when retired; rejected for non-admin callers and when not retired.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.purgeData(), but backend purgeData implementation and its admin/retired-state enforcement are not shown in the provided backend diff snippet.

missing_requirements.requirement: When retired=true, all listed routes render the retired screen for non-admin users, without requiring authentication; primary navigation and tool entry points are not shown to non-admin users.
missing_requirements.reason: App.tsx gates the Outlet behind SiteRetired for non-admins, and SiteHeader hides the navigation, but the header/footer (and other entry points like ToolCards on Home) may still render because Layout always renders <SiteHeader /> and <SiteFooter /> even when retired. The diff does not show Home/tool entry points being hidden when retired.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions Home/ToolCard but does not show retired gating there)

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin page includes admin-only controls to retire site (optional public message) and purge all user data (enabled/visible only after retirement), both with explicit confirmation; UI updates after retire without refresh; errors shown via existing toast/error patterns.
missing_requirements.reason: AdminHomeEditor.tsx shows state for retireMessage/confirmText and imports AlertDialog plus retire/purge hooks, but the diff is truncated before showing the full control section, confirmation dialogs, conditional enablement of purge-after-retire, and status refresh behavior in the UI.

missing_requirements.requirement: Retired screen and admin retirement section share consistent neutral/gray styling; avoid introducing blue/purple-dominant palette.
missing_requirements.reason: Retired theme tokens are added and SiteRetired uses them, but the diff also changes global theme tokens (e.g., --primary/--accent) to warm orange/ember tones and adds glow shadows/animations; the truncated Admin page diff does not show whether the retirement section uses the same retired tokens for consistent shutdown styling.

hallucinated_features.description: Ability to reactivate the website (useReactivateWebsite hook calling actor.reactivateWebsite).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked to retire/disable and optionally purge; it did not request a reactivation feature or backend method.

hallucinated_features.description: New URL parameter/session persistence utilities suggesting admin tokens in URL/sessionStorage (e.g., caffeineAdminToken).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly disallows adding third-party auth/external storage and does not request URL/session-based admin token handling; this appears unrelated to retiring/purging.

hallucinated_features.description: Global visual re-theming beyond the retired experience (warm orange/ember primary/accent colors, new typography/fonts, glow shadows, animations).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-6 asks for a coherent neutral theme specifically for the 'Site Retired' experience and admin retirement section; broad application-wide theme changes are not requested and risk violating the 'do not redesign beyond what is necessary' constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend homepage default branding content changes (e.g., heroBadge text and logo file).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on retiring/disabled mode and data purge; changing marketing/branding defaults is not requested.
